Delighted to share that I have successfully completed my Internship at Yugantar Legals under the guidance of Advocate Saurabh Bishwambhar 
During this internship, I gained practical exposure to legal research, drafting legal notices and documents, case analysis. This experience strengthened my understanding of legal practice and enhanced my research and drafting skills.
Looking forward to applying these learnings in my legal career and continuing to grow.
